title: MapNodeFacets
description: Filterable facets and health of one live-map node (PRP-70 item 4). A fragment schema without schema_version, like actions/v1/target-ref, so the API and the frontend share one shape. Every member is nullable or defaulted, so none is required. Unknown numeric values (error_rate, error_count, request_count) are null, never 0: a zero means a measured zero.

entity_type.description: Catalog entity type of the node; null for cluster nodes.

cloud.description: Cloud boundary of the node; null when unknown.

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle state of the node's entity; null when unknown.

discovery.description: How the node came to be known: declared in the catalog, seen in telemetry, imported, or unknown.

health.description: Observed health of the node. unknown when there is no telemetry window to judge.

error_rate.description: Share of failed requests in the window, 0 to 1; null when unknown (never 0 for unknown).

error_count.description: Failed requests in the window; null when unknown (never 0 for unknown).

request_count.description: Requests in the window; null when unknown (never 0 for unknown).

last_error_at.description: Time of the most recent error; null when none is known.

residency_geography.description: Coarse geography of the node's data; null when not declared.
